tables.title: Verified control masks
tables.description: Bit masks in the native unsigned control byte. These masks can be combined; the table is not a complete enum.
rows: Either low bit suspends the late player movement collision and contact handlers.
Suppresses selected player input actions; does not by itself suspend the late collision handlers.

tables.title: Verified scripted input values
tables.description: Native move-toward sets bit 0; Eocs playback stores 1 during playback and clears the whole byte on completion. Other bit meanings are not established.
rows: Cleared scripted-input ownership after playback completion.
Scripted player-input ownership used by move-toward and playback paths.

tables.title: Character body radius values
tables.description: Unscaled unsigned 16-bit dimensions in the native character order. Multiply by the corresponding render-object scale for world-space dimensions.

tables.title: Character body height values
tables.description: Unscaled unsigned 16-bit dimensions in the native character order. Multiply by the corresponding render-object scale for world-space dimensions.
